Gathering peak immediately before release. Lowest controlled knee bend of cast sequence, chest slightly turned back while face remains strictly right. Near RIGHT forearm is cocked close beside head with five-card fan above shoulder, visible palm and grip; elbow lifted behind fan, no distorted wrist. Far LEFT elbow raised, bronze bell at shoulder height at screen-left behind chest. Clear pause/coiling silhouette; both feet anchored in stagger. No aura or visual effect.

Target's normal highest ponytail/crown silhouette is around14%-15%; allow only physically natural small up/down movement from knee bend, NOT changing character scale. Keep a CLEAR EMPTY 10% bottom transparent margin below the invisible ground. Full body and all props within square canvas, fixed orthographic E side camera, no zoom, no crop or bounding-box auto-fit.
Both hands visible gripping physically; keep five cards distinct as FIVE separate red rectangular panels, no closed folding fan; one bronze bell only. Two clearly separate legs/shoes, realistic knee/ankle joints within short chibi proportions.
Native single square RGBA frame at least1024, intended1024x1024 export. True transparent alpha. No background, ground, shadow, checkerboard, text, labels, detached particles, fire, aura, glow, projectiles or trails. No duplicate/extra anatomy. Bright clean rounded Taoist chibi hand painting, no plastic gloss.
